scope: Exact C2 integrated-quartic derivative perturbation plus one fixed analytic rotational background; shared binary nodes, endpoint derivative jets, physical-midpoint first derivatives and C3 coefficients. Sampling is not a continuous metric/curvature certificate. Planar rr source uses finite differences; ODE and far nonlinear graph errors remain unpaid. Source-critical grid layers use finite-difference width proposals only to choose interpolation nodes. They do not certify the source ODE, and source CP/native flow steps remain separately recorded. Sampled target jets are evaluated at the source profile radius; maxSourceRadiusDisplayDifference records the numerical shift to the exact-sum representation. No continuous certification is inferred from these samples. Each stage endpoint shooting defect is distributed through one physical-r cubic Hermite correction to Fr; its exact derivative corrects Frr. This is part of the finite map definition, not an exact ODE correction.

format.interpretation: Gamma-r exp(i theta)=sum real a_m exp(i m theta); z-h=sum c_m cos(m theta). Fr is the cubic Hermite interpolant of endpoint Fr,Frr plus the quartic bubble t^2(1-t)^2 matching its physical-midpoint value. F is the exact integral from the first endpoint; stored node positions are numerical evaluations only. Thus the model is piecewise quintic and exactly C2, without differentiating quantized point values. Duplicate raw-cell interface rows are byte-identical. Radii and span lengths use radialGeometry, not differences of the displayed cumulative r columns.

gauge: At deepest represented port the nonlinear mean-height perturbation is zero; mean is accumulated outward without resets. Exact fixed h_rot has cuff value zero; stored h_rot values are numerical primitive evaluations, used only for positions, not metric derivatives.

radialGeometry.definition: Each saved final column is an exact binary positive increment ell_i, evaluated by a local radial integral without subtracting absolute radii. beta=(outerAnchor-innerAnchor)/sum_i ell_i is an exact rational. Actual node r_i=innerAnchor+beta*sum_{j<i}ell_j, and each Hermite span has exact length beta*ell_i. Displayed r columns are approximate only. Both radial end anchors are therefore exact. The target rotational metric is unchanged.
